about: Card H11: the user-facing features of the browser app, named the way a person asks for them, and how to reach each one. `node scripts/drive.mjs <id>` opens a feature on a fresh ledger and saves a screenshot; tests/e2e/features.spec.mjs keeps every entry working. Steps: select [selector, value], upload [selector, repository file], fill [selector, text], click selector, waitFor selector (visible).

features.name: Library: import a transcript
features.what: Pick Claude Code or Codex and a transcript file; the ledger imports it and opens it in the reader.

features.name: Library: search transcripts
features.what: Search every imported message, filter by agent, and open a matching transcript.

features.name: Library: read a transcript
features.what: The reader shows each message with its line number, as text, and can delete the transcript.

features.name: Negotiation room
features.what: Open two parties' graphs side by side; people confirm or reject each proposal.

features.name: Review graph nodes
features.what: Approve, edit or reject each node of a version 3 graph beside its evidence.

features.name: Console: live
features.what: The pixel office of agents, the live graph, evidence, activity and the swarm room, from this ledger's data.

features.name: Console: the recorded demo
features.what: The recorded demo played to the end: hand-offs, tokens saved and the proof behind a node.

features.name: Swarm page
features.what: The dataset, the task and the controls to run many agents at once.

features.name: Swarm: a simulated run
features.what: A simulated 100-agent run to the end: each agent's tile, the checks and the combined answer.
